notes.title: Fixed Chat Bug
notes.notes: So... I don't have the source code for this game anymore and playing through it again I noticed a glaring bug (among the many) after getting to the lettuce king where the dialogue was behind one node. I found a tool that unpacks and repacks unity games and lets you modify files to them. I managed to fix the chat text file that contains all the dialogue in the game and fixed the nodes. So! Even though its buggy, its technically playable and has a pretty cool story. Again, sorry it's buggy but it was at a time in my life where I just wanted to finish and had many many things going on, if I could go back, I'd put a little more effort into the release.
